Generate SQL to find the total number of COVID-19 cases worldwide on 2020-04-15 from bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data
result:
SELECT
  SUM(cumulative_confirmed) AS total_covid19_cases_worldwide
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE
  date = '2020-04-15'
  AND aggregation_level = 0;
